activation.note: CI computes sha256 over this file at activation and writes it to the activation record. Every evidence row must carry that SHA. Changing any field requires a new version_id and invalidates all prior evidence collected under this definition.

governance_scope.authority: CFB_TRUTH_GATE_V1 remains authoritative. This policy defines HOW forward evidence is collected, not WHETHER a market promotes.
does_not_change: key-number mass tolerance 1.5pp absolute at +/-3 and +/-7
independent promotion per canonical market; no inheritance
governance_scope.rationale: No verified free historical CFB closing-line source exists, so multi-season paired-price replay cannot be run. Forward capture is the only admissible route to promotion-grade CLV and calibration evidence. This is a change of evidence SOURCE, not a relaxation of the gate.

row_admissibility.model_p_source: run_cfb_auto.py under the hash-bound model-artifact contract
row_admissibility.layer_b_note: HYBRID / RUN IT / market-context cards are Layer B and are PERMANENTLY INADMISSIBLE to this ledger regardless of outcome, price, or apparent quality. They accumulate in the separate RUN IT results ledger.
row_admissibility.backfill_note: No row with a capture timestamp earlier than frozen_at_ct is admissible. Missing capture = row EXCLUDED, never reconstructed.
row_admissibility.wager_note: Every game the engine prices generates a forward decision row (BET or NO_BET at the frozen edge floor). Evidence accrues from model decisions, not from the user's wagering.

opener.scope: all FBS games on the upcoming Saturday-through-Monday slate window

decision.note: The decision price is sealed on write. It is never replaced by a later or closing price. ROI, if computed, uses the decision price only.

close.boundary_note: Validity is determined by actual event start, not scheduled kickoff alone. A capture at scheduled kickoff may remain valid if the event has not actually started. A capture at or after actual start is invalid.
close.selection_note: Deterministic closest candidate that survives live status, DraftKings market-state, freshness, timestamp-precision, and stabilized posthoc first-play checks. No analyst discretion.
close.note: A missed close is a failure of the capture lane, not a reason to drop the row. Dropping missed closes would bias the CLV estimate.
close.status_requirement: PRE_START_ONLY; UNKNOWN, missing, stale, delayed-without-reliable-anchor, or in-progress cannot validate a candidate capture. If no candidate survives, CLV_MISSING and row retained in denominator.
close.book_requirement: DraftKings same-book requested pregame market must be open and two-sided at capture; missing, suspended, stale, or one-sided cannot validate a candidate capture.
close.dual_source_rule: Both authoritative ESPN status and DraftKings pregame market state must independently pass for a candidate capture. Either failure invalidates that candidate; no surviving candidate => CLV_MISSING retained in denominator.

provider_failure_matrix.ESPN_STATUS_MISSING_OR_STALE: candidate INVALID_STATUS_UNVERIFIED; if no later valid candidate => CLV_MISSING_RETAINED_IN_DENOMINATOR
provider_failure_matrix.DRAFTKINGS_MARKET_MISSING_SUSPENDED_OR_O: candidate INVALID_BOOK_STATE; if no later valid candidate => CLV_MISSING_RETAINED_IN_DENOMINATOR
provider_failure_matrix.BOTH_SOURCES_PASS: candidate remains provisional until stabilized first-play attestation
provider_failure_matrix.ATTESTATION_MISSING_AMBIGUOUS_OR_UNSTABL: candidate INVALID_ATTESTATION_UNVERIFIED; if no other valid candidate => CLV_MISSING_RETAINED_IN_DENOMINATOR

actual_start_attestation.snapshot_rule: Fetch first-play/event-start attestation no earlier than 12 hours after final status, canonicalize, hash, and seal that settlement snapshot. Earlier reads are diagnostic only and cannot validate evidence.
actual_start_attestation.fail_closed_rule: Missing timestamp precision, uncertainty >30s, revised/unstable source at seal time, or comparison inside the uncertainty margin => INVALID_ATTESTATION_UNVERIFIED. Never validate an ambiguous near-start quote.
actual_start_attestation.post_start_rule: A quote at or after first play is INVALID_POST_START even if the live status feed lagged.

close.delay_handling: Scheduled kickoff only seeds monitoring. A verified updated kickoff may re-anchor monitoring. If status is DELAYED/PRE_START without a reliable new kickoff, continue polling status/book state without treating scheduled time as the close; eventual selection is the last candidate that survives the stabilized actual-start attestation.
close.postponed_handling: POSTPONED_TO_OTHER_DATE => current close cohort VOID_POSTPONED and never reused; recapture under a fresh scheduled/actual-start window on the new date.

quote_hygiene.low_liquidity_handling: REDUCED_LIMITS quotes are flagged LOW_LIQUIDITY_QUOTE and excluded from promotion-grade CLV; retained as diagnostic.
quote_hygiene.candidate_failure_behavior: Any quote/status hygiene failure invalidates only that candidate observation. If no candidate in the frozen window survives all checks, the decision row remains in denominator with CLV_MISSING.

clv_definition.rule: CLV is measured on the same book, market, side, and exact line number as the decision row. A decision at +3 is compared to the closing price at +3, never to a closing main line of +2.5.
clv_definition.alternate_line_note: At close, capture the alternate-line ladder so the original contract number is priced even after the main line moves off it. This is the primary mechanism that makes exact-contract CLV recoverable in CFB.

normal_approx_v1.reason: NORMAL_APPROX_V1 ignores discrete mass at 3 and 7. CFB is the sport where that error is largest. It must never silently become the promotion methodology.

model_vs_close.note: Model_P minus closing no-vig probability is MODEL_VS_CLOSE, a diagnostic. It is not CLV and does not satisfy the CLV gate.

benchmark.starvation_rule: Once collection begins, books may not be added, removed, or reordered; consensus pricing may not be substituted; a missing side may not be inferred; the close book may not be switched due to poor coverage. A market may finish INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. That is the correct failure mode, not a problem to engineer around.

evidence_requirements_per_market.few_cluster_rule: OFFICIAL inference is prohibited below 12 eligible regular-season slate clusters regardless of decision count. Decision count cannot substitute for independent weekly clusters.

standard_errors.promotion_rule: Require frozen CLV mean threshold, CR1 t-stat >=2.0, and wild-cluster-bootstrap-t two-sided p<=0.05. Bootstrap cannot rescue a failed mean or t-stat gate.
standard_errors.note: The 12-cluster requirement is a hard floor, not a sufficiency claim. Wild cluster bootstrap-t is authoritative for small-G significance; CR1 remains reported and its frozen t-stat gate still applies.

calibration.note: Forward CLV validates the decision policy. Proper scoring validates the probability model. Neither substitutes for the other. Brier and log-loss versus the synchronized no-vig benchmark accumulate from the same forward rows and must independently clear CFB_TRUTH_GATE_V1.

roi.note: Positive ROI cannot rescue failed calibration or failed CLV.

eligible_cluster_regime.note: Postseason/neutral-site/long-layoff/opt-out regimes may not be pooled merely to reach the 12-cluster floor. If 12 regular-season clusters are unavailable in 2026, OFFICIAL remains unavailable.

PAPER.entry: default state for any market with no cleared evidence

PROBATION.entry: checkpoint review passed at >= 150 decisions with positive CLV trend and no hard block

STANDARD.entry: all CFB_TRUTH_GATE_V1 gates cleared on that market's independent ledger

BLOCKED.entry: hard block triggered, or persistent negative CLV versus the close

hard_blocks: post-outcome information present in any feature or decision path
unfrozen or mutated rule applied to a collected row
missing or incorrect pregame price on a decision row
missing genuine Model_P on a model-claimed row
Layer B / market-context row present in this ledger
evidence mixed across sources or lane definitions
stale, UNKNOWN, missing, or in-progress ESPN event status on a candidate close capture
DraftKings pregame market not two-sided/open on a candidate close capture
candidate close capture fails stabilized first-play timestamp precision or uncertainty margin
postseason cluster pooled into regular-season promotion ledger
warnings_not_blocks: key-number mass drift within tolerance band
single missed close within retry policy
parity diagnostic variance below failure threshold

monte_carlo_precision.note: MC precision is a reporting and attestation control only. It can never raise confidence or promotion status.

structural_break.effect: OFFICIAL -> REVOKED immediately, without waiting for rolling calibration decay. Rows from the invalid regime are excluded from any future promotion attempt.
structural_break.re_promotion: requires a new version and SHA, full PIT replay of the admissible window, a fresh Truth Gate pass, and new attestations. No automatic reinstatement.

season_touch_status.note: The forward holdout begins at frozen_at_ct. Any model iteration after this timestamp that is informed by post-freeze results restarts the clock under a new policy version.
